titleZh: 客觀 ↔ 偏頗｜無私鏡 vs 偏執帽
hook: 無私鏡對偏執帽——評價語氣對打。

members.speakLineEn: We need a disinterested judge with no stake in either company's deal.
members.speakLineZh: 我們需要公正無私、與兩家公司交易都無關的法官。

members.speakLineEn: An impartial referee treats both teams by the same written rules.
members.speakLineZh: 不偏不倚的裁判依同一書面規則對待兩隊。

members.speakLineEn: She stayed aloof at the party, watching quietly from the far corner.
members.speakLineZh: 派對上她保持高冷超然，安靜地待在遠角觀望。

related.antonyms: friendly, approachable, attach, attached, sociable, advance, deposit, engage

members.speakLineEn: His clinical tone described the accident without emotional coloring.
members.speakLineZh: 他冷靜客觀的語氣描述意外，不帶情緒色彩。

members.speakLineEn: Their egalitarian policy gave every intern the same training budget.
members.speakLineZh: 他們的平等政策讓每位實習生享有相同培訓預算。

members.speakLineEn: A loud bigot refused to listen to any view that challenged his own.
members.speakLineZh: 一個固執的偏執者拒絕聽任何挑戰己見的觀點。

members.senseAnchor: 蠱惑民心的政客；煽動者
members.speakLineEn: The demagogue stirred anger with slogans instead of workable plans.
members.speakLineZh: 蠱惑民心的政客用口號煽動怒火，卻不提可行計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Partisan coverage praised one candidate and ignored the other's record.
members.speakLineZh: 有偏見的黨派報導讚美一方，卻忽略另一方的紀錄。

members.speakLineEn: The tendentious article selected only facts that supported one side.
members.speakLineZh: 那篇有傾向性的文章只挑選支持單一方的事實。

members.speakLineEn: Missing data can skew survey results toward wealthier neighborhoods.
members.speakLineZh: 資料缺失會使調查結果歪斜偏向較富裕社區。

members.senseAnchor: （因嫉妒或厭世而產生的）偏見；令人厭惡的
members.zhGloss: （因嫉妒或厭世而產生的）偏見
members.speakLineEn: Old rivalry left him with a jaundice toward every rival proposal.
members.speakLineZh: 舊日競爭讓他對對手的每個提案都懷有偏見。

related.synonyms: icterus, bitterness, acrimony, acerbity, tartness, thorniness

members.speakLineEn: A stubborn preconception about rural schools blocked useful reforms.
members.speakLineZh: 對鄉村學校根深蒂固的偏見阻擋了有用的改革。

members.speakLineEn: The slanted headline made a minor delay sound like a national crisis.
members.speakLineZh: 有偏向的標題把輕微延誤說成全國危機。

members.speakLineEn: A biased sample of only city voters cannot represent the whole state.
members.speakLineZh: 只抽城市選民的有偏樣本，無法代表全州。

members.speakLineEn: Teachers must not be partial to students who sit in the front row.
members.speakLineZh: 老師不應偏袒坐在前排的學生。

members.speakLineEn: An evenhanded coach praised effort on both winning and losing teams.
members.speakLineZh: 公平的教練對勝負兩隊的努力都給予肯定。

members.speakLineEn: She stayed detached during the quarrel so she could mediate fairly.
members.speakLineZh: 爭吵時她保持超然，才能公平調解。

members.speakLineEn: Creditors moved to liquidate the failing shop and sell its inventory.
members.speakLineZh: 債權人著手清算倒閉商店並變賣庫存。

members.speakLineEn: The artisan layered bright enamel over the copper plate before firing.
members.speakLineZh: 工匠在銅板上鋪上明亮瓷釉，再送進爐中燒製。

members.speakLineEn: Returning the wallet did not extenuate the fact that he had stolen it.
members.speakLineZh: 歸還皮夾並不能減輕他曾偷竊的罪過。
